correctness.rationale: Independently reproduced the census through order eight by deleting/reinserting the entire minimal antichain (multisets of upsets covering all old minima), with exact within-color isomorphism and joint refinement of the full atomic pair type. The unoriented incomparable and equality counts in the strict-poset signature are determined by the cell totals and the two directed counts, so the frozen directed-only refinement is sufficient. This gives equal isomorphism and C² counts through seven (1,2,5,16,63,318,2045), then 16999 isomorphism types, 16997 classes, and precisely two classes of size two. The first consists of 2C4 versus C8 in the comparability graph. In the second each poset has eight covers incident to the intermediate level, but A2 has two additional bottom-to-top covers and B2 has none; both are connected. Equitable profiles certify the witnesses at every depth. Adding isolated points preserves the common equitable profiles and cannot erase the component distinction in the nonisolated subposet. The empty case is unique.
